events.text:
Cleaned up the workspace. Final deliverable is at `clone.html`.

## Summary

**Built:** A single self-contained clone of `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` at `/Users/cameron/projects/gumshoe/experiments/control-subagent/output/2026-08-30T16-11-05-503Z/clone.html`, using Tailwind via CDN with a custom config (dark `#0b1315` background, gold `#c9ab81` accent, Josefin Sans / Open Sans Condensed / Miniver Google Fonts matching the site's actual theme CSS).

**Approach:**
- Fetched and read the live page's HTML plus its compiled theme CSS to pull real copy verbatim (nav labels, hero heading, all three "About Us" body paragraphs, testimonial quotes/authors, footer address/hours/social links) rather than guessing.
- Identified the JS-driven testimonial carousel and wired it to real Owl Carousel 2 (from cdnjs) instead of hand-rolling one.
- Hotlinked all images (hero photo, video-section background, portrait image, logos) directly from the live site, plus decorative inline SVGs transcribed from the source markup.
- Attempted to hotlink the site's custom `caviar_dreamsbold` webfont but it lacks CORS headers, so it silently fails cross-origin — I substituted bold Josefin Sans (already used elsewhere on the real site) as a close visual match instead of leaving it broken.
- Added a functional slide-out side menu (jQuery toggle) reproducing the site's off-canvas panel, since it was simple enough to implement rather than skip.

**Fidelity check:** Took matched 1280×900 and full-page 1280×3200 screenshots of both the live page and my draft, iterated twice — fixing font fallback, grid-line positioning, video section crop, and paragraph column width — until the sections (header, hero, intro/photo row, video CTA, testimonials, footer) lined up closely in layout, color, and type.

**Tuning sub-agent:** Ran once per instructions (Haiku, ~$0.42, foreground, full 10-min budget). It reported reducing pixel diff from 26.4% to 19.3%, but its one substantive edit — stretching the hero section from the site's actual `530px` to `900px` — was a regression that broke the 1280×900 comparison view. I caught this by re-screenshotting, reverted just that change, and left the rest of its pass (which appeared to be diagnostic/no-op elsewhere) intact. I also cleaned up the debug artifacts (diff images, JSON reports) it left behind in the output directory, leaving only `clone.html`.

resultText:
Cleaned up the workspace. Final deliverable is at `clone.html`.

## Summary

**Built:** A single self-contained clone of `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` at `/Users/cameron/projects/gumshoe/experiments/control-subagent/output/2026-08-30T16-11-05-503Z/clone.html`, using Tailwind via CDN with a custom config (dark `#0b1315` background, gold `#c9ab81` accent, Josefin Sans / Open Sans Condensed / Miniver Google Fonts matching the site's actual theme CSS).

**Approach:**
- Fetched and read the live page's HTML plus its compiled theme CSS to pull real copy verbatim (nav labels, hero heading, all three "About Us" body paragraphs, testimonial quotes/authors, footer address/hours/social links) rather than guessing.
- Identified the JS-driven testimonial carousel and wired it to real Owl Carousel 2 (from cdnjs) instead of hand-rolling one.
- Hotlinked all images (hero photo, video-section background, portrait image, logos) directly from the live site, plus decorative inline SVGs transcribed from the source markup.
- Attempted to hotlink the site's custom `caviar_dreamsbold` webfont but it lacks CORS headers, so it silently fails cross-origin — I substituted bold Josefin Sans (already used elsewhere on the real site) as a close visual match instead of leaving it broken.
- Added a functional slide-out side menu (jQuery toggle) reproducing the site's off-canvas panel, since it was simple enough to implement rather than skip.

**Fidelity check:** Took matched 1280×900 and full-page 1280×3200 screenshots of both the live page and my draft, iterated twice — fixing font fallback, grid-line positioning, video section crop, and paragraph column width — until the sections (header, hero, intro/photo row, video CTA, testimonials, footer) lined up closely in layout, color, and type.

**Tuning sub-agent:** Ran once per instructions (Haiku, ~$0.42, foreground, full 10-min budget). It reported reducing pixel diff from 26.4% to 19.3%, but its one substantive edit — stretching the hero section from the site's actual `530px` to `900px` — was a regression that broke the 1280×900 comparison view. I caught this by re-screenshotting, reverted just that change, and left the rest of its pass (which appeared to be diagnostic/no-op elsewhere) intact. I also cleaned up the debug artifacts (diff images, JSON reports) it left behind in the output directory, leaving only `clone.html`.
